items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: The interviewer mentions Raymond Burketh telling stories about tricks/coffins, but the interviewee (Georg Brunis) does not confirm knowing him, only discusses his own brother in response.

ctx.x: He dropped everything. Monte Gros Day, I walked in there. Dixie and I walked in there. He says, my Uncle George is here. Drop everything. And he had it loaded with these- Oh, he's your nephew then? Yeah, my sister's boy. Abou would have dropped dead. That's my cousin. That's my- Yeah, that's my-

Oh, they tell me too, every once in a while you hear stories about, like you say, you fellows didn't, you all turned out well and all that. But they say that they used to play a lot of tricks and there's something Raymond Burketh started to tell us once about a coffin or something you all fixed up. Maybe, or was that your older brother's? I never asked him about that. A coffin? Yeah, like an undertaker's part of it.
Oh, my brother. Have we played a joke?
